title: Indurex Raises $8 Million to Expand Industrial Cybersecurity Platform
description: Indurex, an Amsterdam-based industrial cybersecurity company, has raised $8 million to fund research and development and expand its commercial operations in Europe and the Middle East. The company develops the SafeGuard AI platform, which analyzes data from industrial control systems and safety instruments to identify anomalies and configuration changes that may require operator attention. Indurex aims to address gaps in conventional operational technology (OT) security tools by integrating engineering, process, safety, and cybersecurity data for better contextual alert assessment. The funding will support expansion into additional markets including the United States and Asia-Pacific.
aiSummary: Indurex is an industrial cybersecurity firm focused on protecting cyber-physical systems used in critical infrastructure and industrial operations. Its SafeGuard AI platform collects and analyzes data from distributed control systems, safety instrumented systems, process historians, alarm management systems, and IT security tools to detect anomalies and changes in engineering configurations and safety functions. This approach targets limitations in traditional OT security tools that primarily focus on network activity, by providing operators with contextualized security alerts linked to physical system operations. The company recently secured approximately $8 million in funding to enhance R&D and expand its market presence in Europe, the Middle East, and beyond.
aiImpact: This is a corporate funding announcement for an industrial cybersecurity platform and does not describe a specific vulnerability or active threat. There is no direct impact on security from this news itself. The platform aims to improve detection and response capabilities for industrial control systems, potentially enhancing security posture for critical infrastructure operators who adopt it.
